text:
Mira (growth): Quick thought — can we run a tiny PLG funnel test tied to the webinar launch? mix of: small free credit, 1-click prompt templates in the console, and a 3-email activation nudge. keep it lightweight.
Alex (content): love it. what are the primary metrics? activation rate (first 5 calls), 7-day retention, cost per activated user?
Mira (growth): yep those three. target: +15% activation, keep cost per activation < $10.
Jordan (product): routing question — do leads from the webinar go to the standard onboarding flow or a special landing with preloaded prompt templates?
Mira (growth): special landing. preloaded prompt packs = better signal. we can tie a URL param: ?source=webinar_promptpack
Sam (analytics): I can wire up the cohort tracking. need a list of template IDs and credit amount per cohort.
Alex (content): propose two prompt packs: "Starter Assistant" (4 templates) and "Domain Focus" (3 industry templates). Copy ready.
Devon (devex): I can add a one-click import in the Console that preloads the selected prompt pack into the user's workspace. will need the template JSON and a feature flag.
Mira (growth): credit sizing: A/B test 150 vs 400 starter tokens. small N to start (2k users each).
Sam (analytics): noted. will create measurement spec: activation = first generation >= 20 tokens within 48h. retention = any gen on day 7.
NiaBot: experiment-flag created: exp/webinar_promptpack_v1. Feature flag id: webinar_pp_1766661234.
Devon (devex): pushed the import button behind webinar_pp_1766661234. URL flow: /onboard?flag=webinar_pp_1766661234&pack=starter
Jordan (product): can we show a micro-benchmark on the landing that compares expected latency/cost for using the native Redwood starter pack vs "bring-your-own-model"? helps set expectations.
Alex (content): short blurb: "Start in seconds with curated prompt packs + free tokens". will draft variants A/B.
Mira (growth): timeline: spin up experiment page + console import by Wed, QA Thurs, soft launch Friday webinar. Sam, make sure tracking is live before soft launch.
Sam (analytics): will post the measurement doc in this thread when done.
Devon (devex): small ask for eng-infra — can we allocate a small dedicated pool for the first 48h to avoid cold-start surprises? pinging ops separately.
Mira (growth): cool. final checklist: creative (Alex), tracking spec (Sam), console import (Devon), landing + micro-bench copy (Jordan/Alex), feature flag (Devon). I'll run a 1-hr sync tomorrow to confirm. :thumbsup:
Alex (content): on it. uploading drafts to /Marketing/Launch/Promptpack-webinar.
Jordan (product): adding a short FAQ: billing, credit expiry, how to revert promptpacks.
Sam (analytics): measurement doc: https://redwood-internal/analytics/experiments/webinar_promptpack_1766661234 — will add segment hooks.
Mira (growth): love it. small one: let's include a post-event email that highlights 2 example prompts that got good outputs. keeps people engaged.
Devon (devex): noted. integration test with Console done locally. will schedule deploy behind flag Fri morning.
Mira (growth): thanks team — excited to see if promptpacks + tiny credit nudges move activation. will follow up after sync.
